headline: Hot French startup ZML releases free product to speed inference across lots of AI chips
snapshot: ZML, a hot French AI startup endorsed by Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, has now released ZML/LLMD, software that could make running AI less costly. The larger angle is AI infrastructure: compute capacity, chip access and data-center economics are increasingly determining which companies can scale products for enterprise and government customers.
